WildSpark 2.2.74 integrates the supplied ForeverLootRollMover 1.3.4 as WildRolls, with author permission.

- Restore the complete module feature set: Edit Mode roll and received-item previews, independent alert positioning, vote counts, gamepad roll support, adjustable scale, spacing and stack direction, preview count, and protected-frame-aware Alt-drag.
- Connect WildRolls to WildSpark's existing saved settings and replace the untranslated localization keys with readable Wild Rolls labels and controls.
- Stop WildGroups from automatically opening its panel or closing Blizzard's group finder after the player's own LFG listing is created or updated.
- Add release-package checks for the WildRolls version/features and the disabled listing hook.
- Add an offline Everloot crowd-observed drop-rate fallback to WildInfo when its existing sources have no numeric rate for that NPC and item. Tooltips identify the estimate and show loot-window sample size, reporter count, confidence tier, and snapshot date; WildInfo's local sample remains the last fallback.
- Include 667 NPC/item rate records across 102 creatures, snapshot dated November 25, 2026. Coverage varies; this snapshot does not include Tainted Shrubbery's Verdant Leaves pairing.
- Keep the Everloot dataset separately licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0, with in-tooltip attribution and its own package notice.
- GitHub package/workflow checks passed. Live in-game behavior was not tested.
